summaries.Romania: Russia's repeated drone incursions into Romanian airspace escalated dramatically with three aircraft downed in 48 hours, prompting diplomatic protests and security reinforcement talks with the US. Meanwhile, Romania faces internal political gridlock as PSD challenges the interim government's authority while pursuing judicial and legislative tactics to regain power.
summaries.Healthcare: Italy achieved a medical breakthrough with the first-ever macular retina transplant restoring vision to a blind patient, while the US healthcare sector grapples with AI integration challenges—from scribe quality concerns to prior authorization automation becoming a strategic business imperative. Healthcare innovation continues despite funding pressures, with significant M&A activity and employer-driven market shifts reshaping coverage models.
summaries.Tech: Apple released iOS/macOS 26.6 with 75+ security fixes ahead of iOS 27, while Amazon filed for a 5,105-satellite network to rival Starlink's iPhone connectivity and Google's AI search now appears in 43% of searches, signaling a fundamental shift in how users discover information online. Chinese AI models like Moonshot's Kimi K3 are challenging US dominance by delivering comparable performance at lower cost.

items.snippet:
